note: Fresh hand-written test set: 60 statements a person might type into the optional 'Anything else you know?' box while leaving an abusive partner in the US. Written from general knowledge, without reading project files or searching the web. Codes are listed only when the words clearly say that way in is there now. Ways in that are over, denied, only guessed at, or held by a safe person (a sister or the person's own mom) get no code. 'living' and 'children_shared' appear only when the words clearly say. All names are made up. Mix: 12 with 0 codes, 20 with 1, 14 with 2, 8 with 3, 3 with 4, 3 with 5.
